mapper.select: SELECT m.memberId, d.userId, d.password, d.name, m.role FROM member m LEFT OUTER JOIN memberDetail d ON m.memberId = d.memberId WHERE d.userId = #{userId} AND d.password = #{password}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBERID, ROLE, STATUS, CREATEDAT, DELETEDAT) VALUES ( #{memberId}, 1, '일반', SYSDATE, NULL)

INSERT INTO MEMBERDETAIL ( MEMBERID, USERID, PASSWORD, EMAIL, PHONE, BIRTH, NAME, UPDATEDAT, REFUNDACCOUNT, BANKNAME, ACCOUNTHOLDER) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{password},#{email}, #{phone}, #{birth}, #{name}, SYSDATE, NULL, NULL, NULL)

INSERT INTO ADDRESS ( ADDRESSID, MEMBERID, RECEIVER, RECEIVERNO, ADDR1, ADDR2, ZIPCODE, ISDEFAULT) VALUES ( ADDRESS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{name}, TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(#{phone}, '-', '')), #{addr1}, #{addr2}, #{zip}, 'yes')
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBERDETAIL SET PASSWORD = #{password}, UPDATEDAT = SYSDATE WHERE USERID = #{userId}
